summary: A package entry file that makes the embedding engine importable from the embeddings folder.
purpose: Lets other code import the embedding engine with a shorter path.
why: Likely reason: the standard way to expose a package's main class. Reason not stated.

inputs: The engine file in the same folder.
outputs: The engine class name, available to other modules.
risks: Any new public class must be added to this list or it cannot be imported this way.
